_title: Lab 6: Conditional probability with Kerala rainfall and floods

T2.text: P(F | J) is the probability of a flood year given that June rain exceeded 500 mm. It is about 0.58, a little higher than the unconditional P(F) of about 0.51, so heavy June rain raises the chance of floods only slightly. The events are not independent, but June rain alone is a weak predictor.
